title: Tear-off band-shaped three-layer filter membrane strip for determining content of metals in air, and making method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a tear-off band-shaped three-layer filter membrane strip for determining the content of metals in air, and a making method thereof, and belongs to the field of laboratory consumable products. The tear-off band-shaped three-layer filter membrane strip comprises a supporting shaft, a metal spraying filter membrane is positioned between an upper filter membrane protection paper and a lower filter membrane protection paper, the metal spraying filter membrane, the upper filter membrane protection and the lower filter membrane protection paper are extension band-shaped structures respectively, two edges of the above three extension bands are glued form one body, or the three extension bands are crimped through a viscose glue integral crimping technology to form one body; and the upper membrane filter paper, the metal spraying filter membrane and the lower filter membrane filter paper are wound with the supporting shaft as an axle to form rolls. One side of the metal spraying filter membrane clinging to the upper filter membrane protection paper is sprayed with a metal salt solution in a pressurized manner through a fixed-point pressurizing uniform mist spraying process, the metal spraying filter membrane and the lower filter membrane filter protection paper uniformly pass by below a fixed-point pressurizing mist nozzle at a same speed, fast drying is carried out after spraying, the upper filter membrane protection paper is covered and then is pressurized for stitching, equidistant breakpoint lines are realized through a laser breaking machine, and rolling and packaging are carried out. The tear-off band-shaped three-layer filter membrane strip has the advantages of simple process, good effect, low cost and very broad application prospect.
